error.detail: until.every_frames must be a whole number of frames in 1..600 (how often the predicate is evaluated). Frames, not ticks: 1.8 deleted the tick budget and Step() runs once per frame. Note that for any `resources.*` path nothing finer than ~204 ticks is observable at all — ResourceCounter.ResourceCounterTick updates on `TicksGame % 204 == 0`.
